verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm buffers, custom schedules, and daily limits ('fine-tune your availability with meeting buffers, custom schedules, and daily limits') as core Calendly availability controls, and a community comment corroborates demand for daily booking caps. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents minimum-notice settings or date-range scheduling windows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of minimum notice period control, explicit documentation of date-range/rolling window limits, and independent hands-on confirmation these specific sub-features work as described.
